annotations.title: Find the DLD area, project or building

description: Turns a name as people say it ("Marina Gate 2", "JVC", "Elite Residence") into the DLD area, project or building, with candidates and a confidence score. Abstains when no candidate is clearly ahead.

area.description: Optional: only look inside this area. Area name or slug: any of the Dubai areas from list_areas, e.g. "Dubai Marina", "jumeirah-village-circle", "JVC" or "Jumeirah Park".

kind.description: Optional: area, project, building or any.

limit.description: Optional: at most this many candidates.

query.description: The name to look up, as the user said it.

name: resolve_entity
title: Find the DLD area, project or building
